summary: Reconcile legacy Fixos workspace evidence and ownership

delivery.outcome: Publish source-bound reconciliation of legacy ticket109 quarantine and ticket110 backup, with actual preservation/restoration, behavioral evidence and precise protected-controller handoff.
nonGoals: No foreign checkout, source, lease or backup-ref mutation
No claim that local evidence grants takeover or deletion
No runtime, dependency or version changes

architecture.decision: Own the canonical analysis and its index only. Observe Git/GitHub and controller state, privately archive and verify recoverability, classify every known criterion and expose unknown ownership. Preserve a digest-bound controller proposal without authoring trusted observations.
architecture.rollback: Revert only the analysis/index through protected delivery; retain private preservation artifacts.

commands: Compare exact Git source/target bytes and criterion inventory; verify preservation restoration
Execute preserved tests against the current target without writing in quarantine
